entries.name: Path of the Berserker
entries.description: Channel Rage into violent fury: extra damage, immunity to fear and charm, retaliation, and an intimidating presence.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: If you use Reckless Attack while raging, the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack takes extra damage: roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: You can't be Charmed or Frightened while raging; if you are when you enter your Rage, the condition ends.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet, you can use your Reaction to make one melee attack against it with a weapon or Unarmed Strike.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description: As a Bonus Action, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation must succeed on a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Strength + Proficiency) or be Frightened for 1 minute (repeats the save at the end of its turns). Once per Long Rest, or by expending a Rage use.

entries.name: College of Lore
entries.description: Gathers lore and magical secrets from every source: extra proficiencies, cutting words, and magical discoveries.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: As a Reaction, when a creature within 60 feet makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, spend a Bardic Inspiration use and subtract the die roll from its result.

features.name: Magical Discoveries
features.description: You learn two spells (cantrips or of a level you have slots for) from the Cleric, Druid, and Wizard lists: they're always prepared and you can swap one whenever you gain a Bard level.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: When you fail an ability check or attack roll you can spend a Bardic Inspiration use and add the die to the d20; if you still fail, the use isn't expended.

entries.name: Life Domain
entries.description: Positive energy and healing: always-prepared spells, boosted cures, and Preserve Life.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: When a spell you cast with a slot restores Hit Points, the creature regains additional Hit Points equal to 2 plus the slot's level.

features.name: Life Domain Spells
features.description: Always-prepared spells: level 3 Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration; 5 Mass Healing Word, Revivify; 7 Aura of Life, Death Ward; 9 Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.description: As a Magic action, expending a Channel Divinity use: restore Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level, divided among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet (none above half its Hit Point maximum).

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: When you heal others with a spell using a slot, you also regain 2 plus the slot's level Hit Points.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: When you would roll dice to restore Hit Points with a spell or Channel Divinity, use the highest number possible for each die.

entries.name: Circle of the Land
entries.description: A mystic tied to a land type: circle spells, Land's Aid, and nature's protection.

features.name: Circle of the Land Spells
features.description: After a Long Rest choose a land type (arid, polar, temperate, tropical): the spells listed for your level and lower are prepared. Arid: 3 Blur, Burning Hands, Fire Bolt; 5 Fireball; 7 Blight; 9 Wall of Stone. Polar: 3 Fog Cloud, Hold Person, Ray of Frost; 5 Sleet Storm; 7 Ice Storm; 9 Cone of Cold. Temperate: 3 Misty Step, Shocking Grasp, Sleep; 5 Lightning Bolt; 7 Freedom of Movement; 9 Tree Stride. Tropical: 3 Acid Splash, Ray of Sickness, Web; 5 Stinking Cloud; 7 Polymorph; 9 Insect Plague.

features.name: Land's Aid
features.description: Magic action, expending a Wild Shape use: choose a point within 60 feet; in a 10-foot-radius Sphere creatures of your choice make a Constitution save or take 2d6 Necrotic damage (half on a success), and one creature of your choice regains 2d6 Hit Points. 3d6 at level 10, 4d6 at level 14.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: You can cast one of your Circle spells without a slot (once per Long Rest); after a Short Rest you recover slots with a combined level up to half your Druid level (rounded up), none above level 6, once per Long Rest.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: You have Immunity to the Poisoned condition and Resistance to a damage type tied to your chosen land (arid: Fire; polar: Cold; temperate: Lightning; tropical: Poison).

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: Magic action, expending a Wild Shape use: spectral trees and vines fill a 15-foot Cube within 120 feet for 1 minute; you and your allies have Half Cover and allies gain the Resistance from Nature's Ward. Bonus Action: move the Cube up to 60 feet.

entries.name: Champion
entries.description: Physical excellence in combat: more frequent critical hits, athleticism, and resilience.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attack rolls score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. After you score a Critical Hit you can move up to half your Speed without Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: You gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Heroic Warrior
features.description: During combat, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration whenever you start your turn without it.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attack rolls score a Critical Hit on an 18-20.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: Advantage on Death Saving Throws; a 18-20 counts as a 20. At the start of your turn, if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point, you regain 5 + your Constitution modifier Hit Points.

entries.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
entries.description: Master of unarmed combat: pushes, topples opponents, and heals themself.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description: When you hit with an attack from Flurry of Blows you can impose one effect: Addle (no Opportunity Attacks until its next turn), Push (Strength save or pushed up to 15 feet), or Topple (Dexterity save or Prone).

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.description: As a Bonus Action roll your Martial Arts die and regain Hit Points equal to the roll + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Fleet Step
features.description: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind right after it.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.description: When you hit with an Unarmed Strike you can spend 4 Focus Points to start imperceptible vibrations (lasting days equal to your Monk level). With an action (or by forgoing an attack) you end them: Constitution save, 10d12 Force damage on a failure, half on a success. One creature at a time.

entries.name: Oath of Devotion
entries.description: Ideals of justice and order: Sacred Weapon, devotion auras, and a holy nimbus.

features.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
features.description: Always-prepared spells: level 3 Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith; 5 Aid, Zone of Truth; 9 Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic; 13 Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith; 17 Commune, Flame Strike.

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.description: When you take the Attack action, expending a Channel Divinity use, you imbue a melee weapon for 10 minutes: add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to attack rolls, you can deal Radiant damage, and it sheds Bright Light (20 feet) and Dim Light (20 feet more).

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: You and your allies can't be Charmed while in your Aura of Protection; a Charmed ally that enters it has the condition suspended while inside.

features.name: Smite of Protection
features.description: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and your allies gain Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.description: Bonus Action: for 10 minutes the aura deals Radiant damage (Charisma + Proficiency) to enemies that start their turn in it, shines with sunlight, and gives you Advantage on saves against Fiends and Undead. Once per Long Rest (or by expending a level 5 slot).

entries.name: Hunter
entries.description: Protects nature and people: Hunter's Lore and Prey, and defensive tactics.

features.name: Hunter's Lore
features.description: While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know whether it has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and what they are.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: Choose: Horde Breaker (once per turn, when you attack with a weapon you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target) or Colossus Slayer (+1d8 damage to a creature that is missing Hit Points, once per turn). You can change the choice after a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: Choose: Multiattack Defense (after a creature hits you, its other attack rolls against you this turn have Disadvantage) or Escape the Horde (Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage). You can change after a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
features.description: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by Hunter's Mark, you can also deal its extra damage to a different creature you can see within 30 feet of the first.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: When you take damage you can use your Reaction to gain Resistance to it and other damage of that type until the end of the current turn.

entries.name: Thief
entries.description: Treasure hunter and burglar: fast hands, climbing, magic items, and a double first turn.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: As a Bonus Action: a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock, disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools, or pick a pocket; or take the Utilize or Magic action to use a magic item.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and you use Dexterity instead of Strength to determine your jump distance.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: New Cunning Strike option: Stealth Attack (1d6): if you're Invisible from the Hide action, the attack doesn't end that condition if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.description: Charges: when you use a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6; on a 6 no charge is expended. Scrolls: you can use any spell scroll with Intelligence (cantrips and level 1 without a check; higher needs an Intelligence (Arcana) check DC 10 + spell level, else it crumbles). You can attune to up to four magic items.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: You take two turns during the first round of any combat: the first at your normal Initiative and the second at your Initiative minus 10.

entries.name: Draconic Sorcery
entries.description: Innate dragon magic: resilience, draconic spells, elemental affinity, wings, and a dragon ally.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and by 1 again whenever you gain a Sorcerer level. While not wearing armor your base AC is 10 + Dex + Cha.

features.name: Draconic Spells
features.description: Always-prepared spells: level 3 Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath; 5 Fear, Fly; 7 Arcane Eye, Charm Monster; 9 Legend Lore, Summon Dragon.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: Choose a draconic damage type (Acid, Cold, Lightning, Fire, or Poison): you gain Resistance to it and, when you cast a spell of that type, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: Bonus Action: dragon wings for 1 hour (or until dismissed) with a Fly Speed of 60 feet. Once per Long Rest, or by spending 3 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Dragon Companion
features.description: You can cast Summon Dragon without Material components and once without a slot per Long Rest; you can cast it without Concentration (duration 1 minute).

entries.name: Fiend Patron
entries.description: A pact with the Lower Planes: Temporary Hit Points, fiery spells, luck, and Hurl Through Hell.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points (or an enemy within 10 feet of you drops to 0) you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier + Warlock level (minimum 1).

features.name: Fiend Spells
features.description: Always-prepared spells: level 3 Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion; 5 Fireball, Stinking Cloud; 7 Fire Shield, Wall of Fire; 9 Geas, Insect Plague.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: After seeing the roll of an ability check or saving throw you can add 1d10 to it (once per roll). Uses equal your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: After a Short or Long Rest choose a damage type (except Force): you have Resistance to it until you choose a different one.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with an attack roll you can send the target to the Lower Planes: Charisma save or, if it isn't a Fiend, it takes 8d10 Psychic damage and is Incapacitated until the end of your next turn. Once per Long Rest (or by expending a Pact Magic slot).

entries.name: Evoker
entries.description: A specialist in explosive elemental effects: boosted and controlled Evocation spells.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: Add two Wizard Evocation spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free; whenever you gain access to a new slot level you add another.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: When you miss with a cantrip or the target succeeds on its save, it still takes half the cantrip's damage (but suffers no additional effect).

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: When you cast an Evocation spell affecting creatures you can see, choose 1 + the spell's level of them: they automatically succeed on the save and take no damage even when it would be halved.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: You add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard Evocation spell.

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: When you cast a Wizard spell of level 1-5 that deals damage you can deal maximum damage; the first time with no ill effect, afterward 2d12 Necrotic damage per spell level (+1d12 for each further use) before a Long Rest.
